title: Setuid bit set (shell) — review required
description: A file gains the setuid bit: chmod 4755 helper. It then runs with the owner's privileges for every caller, so any flaw in it becomes privilege escalation. This lexical rule flags the bit; the reviewer confirms the binary is minimal and audited or drops the bit.
remediation: Drop setuid in favor of capabilities or a privileged helper service; if it must stay, minimize the binary and audit it.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the bit regardless of binary safety.
